caption: Mini kimbap is my favorite go-to lunch option for my 2 year old toddler because it’s nutritious, easy to make, and can be customized to suit their dietary needs.  Here’s a simple recipe:  1. Cook short-grain rice (optional to season with salt)  2. Lay a sheet of dried seaweed  3. Spread a think layer of rice evenly on top  4. Add strips of carrots (cooked or raw), cucumbers, and cooked eggs  5. Roll the seaweed tightly, applying gentle pressure to secure the filling  6. Slice the roll into bite-sized pieces with a sharp knife.  #healthyrecipes #BLW #babyledweaning #toddlermeal #kidsmeal #familymeal #healthymeal #mealprep Toddler meal ideas, Vegetables, balanced meals
